_doc: Canonical stage list for the long-form world (one or more 16:9 talking-head recordings -> an edited YouTube video with tight jump cuts, chapters and B-roll). Selected by project.config.json format:"long" (NOT inferred from rush/). Same stage grammar as reel-speech.json / broll-montage.json. No motif/scene layer, no sound_fx, no safe_check (short-form concept). Design: docs/design/long-form.md.

stages.title: Coarse cut plan (long pauses / dead air)
Correct the transcript
stages.note: Read build/transcript-raw.json and correct every sentence with the user (rule #5). Write build/transcript-fixes.json ({fix:[[...]], hot:[...]}). Each sentence's word count must equal Whisper's. See SKILL.md step 5.

stages.title: Jump-cut + filler pass
stages.note: Run `uv run scripts/tighten.py <work>` to propose word-level cuts (inter-phrase gaps > longform.pauseMs, fillers from scripts/fillers.json). Show the user the summary, then `tighten.py <work> apply` folds it into build/cut-plan.json + build/captions.json. See docs/design/long-form.md.

stages.title: Chapter markers
stages.note: Optional. Read the transcript, propose chapter breaks to the user, write config/chapters.json ([{ref, title}] — ref binds to a caption sentence). No file -> one continuous video, no markers. See docs/design/long-form.md.

stages.title: B-roll cutaways
stages.note: Optional. Put cutaway clips in rush/broll/, mark ranges in config/broll.json ([{ref, clip, crop}]). montage_mode.py's scorer picks the best moment of each. No file -> no cutaways. See docs/design/long-form.md.
